Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd will open the batting for Netherlands. David Willey will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

We feel England have batted the Dutch out of this game! If Netherlands do chase this down, it is going to be one of the biggest surprises in the history of cricket. What will be interesting to see is their approach. Will they go for it or will they be content in batting out the 50 overs? England on the other hand will love to bowl their opposition out as quickly as possible. Stay tuned for the chase.

Have to feel sorry for Netherlands' bowlers. Not a lot you can do when the England batters were in that mood. Just the one bowler went for below 9 per over and that was Logan van Beek who was outstanding. The rest though would never want to look back at their figures in this game. Netherlands however, will be highly disappointed with their fielding. Had they taken the catches, England might have ended 30-40 short of what they scored. Overall though, it has been a forgetful day for the hosts so far.

Let me remind you, England got off to the worst possible start as they lost Jason Roy in the second over but after that, it was all England. Philip Salt, Dawid Malan and Jos Buttler all scored tons with incredible strike rates. First Malan and Salt put up a partnership of over 200 with both scoring tons. Salt fell but then Malan and Buttler continued the good work. Buttler came out all guns blazing. He was given a couple of chances earlier, which proved to be very costly. He smashed the bowlers all around and scored a ton at a strike rate of over 200. Malan fell but Liam Livingstone blasted his way to yet another fifty to take England extremely close to the 500-run mark. Liam Livingstone notched up his half-ton in just 17 balls and holds the record for the fastest half-ton by an England player.

OUTSTANDING! UNREAL! Just lost for words at the moment! What hitting! Crazy stuff from England! They have broken their own record of the highest ODI score in a game. Total carnage. They will be disappointed they did not cross the 500-run mark which seemed possible at one stage but they have missed that mark by just. Just brilliant!

SIX! KABOOM! Liam Livingstone finishes innings off in style! A low full toss, on the pads. Liam Livingstone dispatches this one over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. England set the highest ODI total ever! They end at 498 for 4! Outrageous stuff!
FOUR! Full again, around middle. Liam Livingstone heaves this in the gap between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary. England move to 492!
Full, and outside off. Jos Buttler pushes it past extra cover for a single.
SIX! There it is! A fuller ball, around middle. Jos Buttler hoicks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. ENGLAND SET A NEW WORLD RECORD! THEY SET THE HIGHEST ODI TOTAL! Can they reach 500?
Another fuller ball, around off. Jos Buttler lifts it over towards deep cover. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce. Two taken! England are one away from setting a World record!
A pitched up delivery, around off. Jos Buttler drills it wide of long off for a brace.

A yorker, around middle. Jos Buttler digs it out towards mid-wicket for a single. No boundary in that over! A rare over! But a good one for Netherlands. England are 5 runs away from setting the highest ODI total!
Just the one again! Outstanding stuff from Logan van Beek! He has not gone for a boundary so far in this over with a ball to go. Outside off, a yorker, it is jammed out towards cover for one.

150 for Buttler! Outstanding innings! We have witnessed some wonderful ball-striking and everybody is up on their feet for Jos! A yorker outside off, Buttler looks to jam it out, it goes off the inner half towards the leg side for one.
This is really good from Logan! Not easy to hit these, a low full toss outside off, Liam hits it towards cover and scampers across for one.
A yorker outside off, this is jammed through covers for one.
Two! 10 runs away now from recording the highest score in an ODI game. A full toss outside off, Buttler hits it a little too close than he would liked towards sweeper cover. Two taken.
Slower again, full and outside off. Liam Livingstone looks to go downtown again but misses.
Wide! Slower, shorter, down the leg side. Liam Livingstone leaves it alone.

SIX! Bang! Liam Livingstone brings up his half-century in some fine fashion! A pitched up ball, around middle. Liam Livingstone dispatches this one straight down the ground for a biggie. That's the fastest half-ton for England! An outrageous innings from Liam Livingstone!
A length ball, this one cuts back in around his pads. Liam Livingstone steps down and tries to pull this one but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Swing and a miss! A fuller ball, outside off. Liam Livingstone swings his bat at it but he misses. He can't get past AB de Villier's record of the fastest half-century!

DROPPED! Oh, dear! Another drop catch! A length ball, around off. Liam Livingstone heaves this one towards deep square leg. The fielder comes charging to his left, tries to take the catch, but he makes a mess of it. Two taken!
FOUR! Full and wide of off. Liam Livingstone smashes this over extra cover once again for a boundary. Can Liam Livingstone break the fastest half-century record here?
Pitches it up, around middle. Liam Livingstone knocks it down to long on for a single. The highest ODI score is 481. England are inching closer to that!
FOUR! Logan van Beek serves an overpitched delivery, outside off. Liam Livingstone thumps it over extra cover for a boundary.
Wide! Very full, wide of off. Liam Livingstone leaves it alone. Wide called!

Logan van Beek hits the deck hard now, around middle and off. Liam Livingstone looks to pull this but he misses and gets hit on his helmet. The physio comes out to conduct the mandatory concussion test.
FOUR! This is a wide full toss, around off. Liam Livingstone smacks this over extra cover for a boundary. A full toss to Liam Livingstone will be dispatched!
A rare dot ball! Pitches this one up, around middle. Liam Livingstone pushes it back to the bowler.
Wide yorker, outside off. Jos Buttler digs it out towards cover for a single.

SIX! KABOOM! Fourth maximum of the over! Fuller ball from round the wicket, around off. Liam Livingstone slog-sweeps this just over the leaping fielder at deep mid-wicket for a biggie. 32 runs of that over! Philippe Boissevain has gone for 108 in his spell! He now has the 4th worst figures in an ODI game. Only Rashid Khan, Wahab Riaz and Mick Lewis went for more runs than him.
FOUR! Oh, dear! This is absolute carnage! Short now, outside off. Liam Livingstone slaps it past cover for a boundary.
SIX! MAKE THAT THREE IN A ROW! Liam Livingstone doing what he does the best! Full again, around middle. Liam Livingstone hangs back and smashes this straight down the ground for yet another biggie!
SIX! Back-to-back sixes! This is even better! Full again, around middle. Liam Livingstone smokes this straight down the ground for another biggie.
SIX! Bang! A fuller ball, around middle and off. Liam Livingstone gets down on his knee and smashes this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
FOUR! First boundary for Liam Livingstone! A shorter ball, around middle. Liam Livingstone pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
SIX! Jos Buttler continues his merry way! A fuller ball, tad quicker, around off. Jos Buttler gets under it and dispatches this over long off for a biggie.
Hat-trick avoided by Liam Livingstone! A fuller ball, around middle. Liam Livingstone knocks it down to long on for a single. He gets off the mark straightaway!

OUT! LBW! Two in two for Pieter Seelaar! Double strike for and Eoin Morgan departs for a golden duck. Pieter Seelaar is on a hat-trick! A fuller ball, much starighter, around middle and off. Eoin Morgan gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he misses. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire says no! Pieter Seelaar seems confident and opts for a review. No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates, three reds! What a review this is from Netherlands! They have got rid of the England skipper, Eoin Morgan now. Liam Livingstone walks out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Netherlands have managed to break this stand! Pieter Seelaar strikes and sends back Dawid Malan after a beautiful innings! A fuller ball, tosses it up, around middle. Dawid Malan gets down on his knee and slog-sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes off the top edge and towards the fielder there. Bas de Leede takes a good catch. England have lost their third wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Pieter Seelaar

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Wide of off, fuller ball, quicker one. Dawid Malan leaves it alone. Wide called!
FOUR! Pulls his length back a tad, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan flicks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Tosses it up, very full, around off. Jos Buttler drills it down to long off for a single.
Just the one and Buttler keeps strike! On off, this is hit hard down the ground. Long off runs to his right and stops it. A single.
SIX MORE! That is like a baseball shot! On off, tossed up, Buttler whacks it by clearing the front leg, over the mid-wicket fence for yet another biggie. 400 up.
EASY TWO! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of long on for a couple.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit towards long on for only one.
SIX! Malan now joins the act! That is a massive hit too and as straight as it gets! On middle, Malan skips down the track and tonks it over the long off fence.
On off, this is hit back to the bowler.

Buttler completes two in the end! Not sure if he wanted the second. Full and outside off, this is hit through covers. They take one, Malan is off for a second, Buttler then goes for it too, the throw is at his end but eh gets in in time.
Just the one! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Just the one off the freebie! A yorker, slower one, it is hit down to long on for one.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, this is jammed out towards wide long on for two. NO BALL TOO! Free Hit coming up! However, all the balls are like a Free Hit for Buttler.
FOUR! Just over! Raining boundaries at the moment! Full and outside off, this is lifted over covers for another boundary.
A rare swing and a miss! Outside off, fuller. Buttler looks to jam it out but misses.

SIX! This is just unreal! We swa Bairstow doing something in a Test match a few days ago and now it is Buttler! This is full and on off, it is smashed over the long off fence for a biggie. 150 run stand up. Buttler has 120 off it.
Buttler probably wants to keep strike and hence, gently pushes it through covers for one.
SIX! There is just nowhere you can bowl to this man! Dutt now switches to over the wicket but the result is the same! On middle, it is heaved over the mid-wicket fence.
SIX! Two in a row! This time down the ground! Fuller and on middle, this is thumped over the long off fence for a maximum.

SIX! 100 for JOS BUTTLER! His Indian T20 League form continues! He also now holds the record for the second fastest ton in ODIs for England. He has had luck on his side but he deserves it. He has played fearlessly and has played some audacious stroke. Outstanding. On middle, shorter and it is pulled over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Really good running! Buttler just wants the strike! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled behind square on the leg side. He takes one, has to rush for the second and completes it.
Smacked away! Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
A yorker now on middle, Buttler jams it back to the bowler. A really good ball to end and a decent over too according to the amount of runs the other bowlers are going for.
Full and outside off, Buttler does well to reach it, it goes through point for two.
Two more! Edgy runs! Outside off, another yorker, Buttler reaches out for it, it goes off the inside edge down to fine leg. The fielder runs to his right, dives and saves two for his side.
Nails it this time! A rare dot ball! A yorker outside off, Buttler lets it be.
WIDE! Tries to bowl it away from Buttler's hitting arc but bowls it wide outside off. Left alone.
SIX! That is huge, massive! Logan misses the length and he goes the distance. Full and on middle, this is thumped over the long on fence for a biggie.
Can't do a lot with that ball! Malan though does the right thing by giving the strike to Jos! A yorker on middle, this is jammed down to long on for one.

FOUR! Jos Buttler is toying with the bowler here! Shorter, around off. Jos Buttler waits for it and upper cuts it over short third man for a boundary. 21 runs off the over! Jos Buttler moves on to 83 with that.

SIX! KABOOM! This is bigger and better! Bas de Leede changes his length and still gets punished! He goes fuller now, around the leg pole. Jos Buttler clears his front leg and smokes this high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! And again! A slower, shorter ball, around middle and leg. Jos Buttler once again, shuffles across and ramps it over fine leg for another boundary. Consecutive boundaries for Jos Buttler!
FOUR! Oh, beautiful shot! That's classical Jos Buttler! A shorter ball, around middle. Jos Buttler shuffles across and scoops it over fine leg for a boundary.
A fuller ball, angling in on the pads. Jos Buttler flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
A length delivery, outside off. Dawid Malan cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Leg bye! Slower ball, short in length. Dawid Malan looks to pull but he misses and gets hit on his stomach. The ball goes towards square leg and the batters sneak in a leg bye!
FOUR! Lovely shot! A fuller ball, around middle. Dawid Malan chips it effortlessly in the gap between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Spills this down the leg side, short in length. Dawid Malan misses his pull shot. Wide called!
Another back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Jos Buttler dabs it towards backward point for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! Logan van Beek drops it short, takes the pace off this ball, serves it outside off. Jos Buttler slaps it past the diving fielder at cover for a boundary.
A length delivery, around off. Dawid Malan pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Overpitched delivery, around off. Jos Buttler looks to hoick this over mid-wicket, but the ball goes off the inside edge onto his pads. It rolls towards short third man the batters rotate the strike!
Fuller now, around middle and off. Jos Buttler miscues his reverse-sweep past point for a single. He retains the strike! 300 up for England!
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep square leg for a single.
Drops it short again, around middle. He cramps Buttler for room there. Jos Buttler pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, maintains the same length. Dawid Malan makes room and pushes it towards deep cover. One run taken!
Flatter, too short on this occasion, around middle and off. Jos Buttler swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Quicker, flatter, shorter, around middle. Jos Buttler pushes it off the back foot towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Shorter ball, around middle. Jos Buttler drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! BANG! Jos Buttler brings his half-century in style! What a blistering knock this has been from him! An overpitched delivery, slower one, around off. Jos Buttler picks up the slower ball and dispatches this over long off for a biggie. His 21st ODI century!
Back of a length, outside off. Dawid Malan pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tad shoter, around off. Dawid Malan hangs back and blocks it out.
Back of a length, slower in pace, around middle and off. Jos Buttler nudges it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
On a length, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Did try the slog sweep but it goes off the inner half to short fine leg.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.

100 for Malan! He becomes only the second English player after Buttler to score a ton in all three formats. Lovely knock, very fluent and a typical Malan knock! He gets there by working this mid-wicket for two. Will we now see him tee off?
WIDE! Malan misses out! Short and down the leg side, Malan looks to pull but misses. Wided.
Short and on middle, Buttler pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Lovely batting! We saw power in the last over but this time the deft touch! Shorter and outside off, this is guided past short third man for a boundary.
Buttler keeps strike as he works this through mid-wicket.

DROPPED! This was an absolute sitter! Musa gives Buttler another life! He is not someone you would want to give a chance! This is tossed up, really full, Buttler fails to get under it, hits it flat and hard down towards long off. It goes straight to him but he spills it. No run taken as Buttler thought he was a goner.
SIX! Buttler is in the mood now! That drop is going to cost a lot! This is tossed up, yet again in the arc, full and on middle, this is lofted over the long on fence for a biggie.
Difficult to get under those! A yorker outside off, this is jammed out through point for two.
SIX! BANG! Two in a row! This on is into the crowd! On middle, this is lofted over the long on fence for another maximum. Buttler has decided to up the ante now.

SIX! That has been misjudged! It should have been an easy catch for long on. Tossed up on off, this is lofted down the ground towards long on. The fielder runs in, realizes it is going over his lead, and leaps but it goes over and over the fence. Costly miss.
Shorter again and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
On middle, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Moves onto 98! Tossed up on off, the reverse paddle comes out again, it is played fine on the off side for two.
Another two! A boundary away now from a ton! Tossed up outside off, it is driven through covers for two.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
The ball is being replaced for the second time today!
SIX! Over the fence! On middle, tossed up, this is heaved over the long on fence for a biggie. That was right in Buttler's arc and it goes out of the park.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Steps out but the length is shortened, it is pushed to covers.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! He moves into the 90s in style! Fuller and on off, this is caressed through covers for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
This is nicely flighted and on off, it is driven to covers.
Buttler fails to put that away! Shorter and on off, this one turns away. It is dragged to mid on.
FOUR! Thumped hard! Fuller and on off, this is hammered down to the long on fence.
On off, defended.
On off, kept out.
Lands short! Outside off, Dawid Malan looks to cut, it goes more off the top edge to the right of the point fielder. Lands short and a single is taken.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Good-length delivery, angling in around middle and off. Jos Buttler defends it out.
Shorter ball, darting it around the thigh pads. Dawid Malan flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Jos Buttler comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally! Netherlands have managed to break this stand at last. Logan van Beek comes back into the attack and strikes! He serves a slower ball, short in length, wide of off. Philip Salt stays in his crease and tries to cut this over the short third man. But the ball goes off the top edge and Philippe Boissevain runs and takes a good catch. That ends a terrific knock!
Commentary.Howout: c Philippe Boissevain b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, on a length. Philip Salt taps it towards point.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Back of a length, around middle. Philip Salt swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg. The fielder there, runs to his left, and slides to stop the ball, but he fails to do so. It rolls behind him for a boundary.

Leg bye! A length ball, darting it on the pads, at around 135 clicks. Dawid Malan looks to flick but he misses. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards square leg. The batter sneaks in a leg bye!
SIX! High and Handsome! A tossed up ball, full toss and around off. Philip Salt dances down the ground and slaps this high over long on for a biggie. That's gone out of the ground!
Quicker, shorter, around off. Dawid Malan cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Tosses this one up, around off. Philip Salt pushes this towards cover for a single.
Quicker, flatter, this one comes in with the arm, around the leg pole. Philip Salt gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he misses and gets rapped on his front pad.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan flicks it towards square leg for another run.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Philip Salt nudges this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Philip Salt drills it straight down the ground. The ball deflects off the stumps at the non-striker's end and rolls away. Single to end the over!
FOUR! Crunched! Oh, this is way too easy for England! On a length, outside off. Philip Salt slaps it through cover for a cracking boundary.
FUR! Top shot! Third boundary of the over! On the pads, tad fuller. Philip Salt flicks it towards deep square leg for a boundary. That brings up the 200-run partnership between these two!
On a length, outside off. Dawid Malan dabs it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Another pitched delivery, on the pads this time. Dawid Malan uses his wrists and flicks it past mid-wicket for another boundary. He moves on to 83 with that!
FOUR! Up and over! Wide of off, fuller in length. Dawid Malan presses forward and drives it uppishly over cover-point for a boundary.
Full again, darting it on the pads. Dawid Malan clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Dawid Malan flicks it fine past short fine leg for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around middle and off. Philip Salt knocks it down to long on for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan works it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Dawid Malan pushes it to the fielder at cover.

Shorter ball, around middle. Philip Salt pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. That will be 100 for Philip Salt! His maiden ODI century. He jumps in the air, removes his helmet, raises his bat, and soaks in all the applause. He top-class innings from him!
Around middle, this is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Salt moves onto 99! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fires it on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Two more! Outside off, this is hit through covers for two.
FOUR! This one runs away to the fence! Fuller and outside off, this is played fine, the reverse sweep, it races towards the third man fence.
EDGY FOUR! Boundaries keep coming in one way or the other! Outside off, Salt slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one more.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Another single as this is slapped through covers.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to short fine leg for one.
Shane Snater (4-0-21-1) comes back to bowl.
On off, this is lifted over covers for one.
A single as this is worked through square leg.
On off, Salt pushes it to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.

A collision but no harm done! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers. They take one and go for the second. Malan has to hurry as the throw is to his end. He gets in but collides with the keeper.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for two.
Half an appeal for a stumping but nothing! Outside off, Salt looks to play the slog sweep but misses. The keeper whips the bails off and appeals but turned down.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Nothing from the Free Hit! Slower and drags his length back. Malan looks to play the slog sweep but misses oto get hit on the pads.

NO BALL AND TWO! No ball is for stepping on the side crease! Lovely shot and really good fielding! This is tossed up on off, it is driven over covers. Vikramjit Singh runs to his right from long off. He pushes the ball back in which stops just before touching the ropes. It is checked but only two given. Free Hit coming up.
Very nicely played! The paddle scoop comes out, it is played nice and fine on the off side for two.
Darts this on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! Powerful hit! This is shorter and on middle, Salt hangs back and smashes it through square leg. The fielder in the deep, runs to his left, dives but he has no chance. 150 up.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one. That's 50 for Dawid Malan! His third in ODI cricket. It's been a composed innings so far from him.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Tosses this one up, full, down the leg side. Dawid Malan clips it towards short fine leg. Two dots to end the over!
Flatter, quicker, around off. Dawid Malan pushes it towards short cover.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Philip Salt drives it down to long off for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Dawid Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Oh, shot! Stand and deliver! An overpitched delivery, around off. Dawid Malan stays in his place and tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Quicker, shorter, leg-break on this occasion. Philip Salt knocks it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Pitched it up now, darting it on his toes. Philip Salt flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Dawid Malan pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Tad short again, tighter line now, around the off pole. Dawid Malan pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! This short and wide of off. Dawid Malan hangs back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Fuller ball, around middle. Philip Salt knocks it down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, darting it on the pads, down the leg side. Philip Salt looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Fuller ball, slower through the air. Dawid Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
On middle, Dawid Malan blocks it out.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Philip Salt nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle and off. Philip Salt lifts it over the bowler's head. The fielder from long off will cut it out. Two taken!
WIDE! Short and very wide outside off, Salt looks to cut but misses.
On the bounce! Malan comes down the track and lifts it towards wide long off. It goes on the bounce to the fielder. A run taken.
A single now as this is eased down to long on.
Fuller and on off, this is hit to cover.
Angled into the pads, Salt flicks it down to fine leg for one.
Well fielded! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled towards deep square leg. Fine leg gets across, dives and keeps it down to one.
Fuller and on off, it is pushed towards mid off for one.
Nice shot for two! Shorter and on off, this is slapped through covers for a couple.
Another full ball, this is yet again driven back to the bowler.
On the pads, Malan clips it to square leg.
Flatter and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, this is dragged down to long on for one.
Short and outside off, Salt looks to cut but is beaten.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on the pads, this is worked to short fine leg.
Length now and on off, Salt plays it back to the bowler.
SIX! SMACK! Change in length and Salt makes Logan pay! Short and outside off, this is dragged over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Yet another dot! Fuller and on off, it is pushed to mid off.
Really good from Logan! This is fuller and on off, it is pushed back to his left, he sticks on hand out and stops it. Salt did take a few steps ahead but then has to get back quickly.
Shorter and outside off, Malan waits and then guides it past point for one.
Really good running again! On middle, this is pushed to mid on for a quick run.

DRINKS! After losing Jason Roy in the second over, England have been cruising along swiftly and have scored runs at a brisk rate. Philip Salt and Dawid Malan have put together over 100 runs so far, with the former being the aggressor between the two. The hosts did have a chance to take the wicket of Philip Salt, but that catch was put down. It's already proving to be costly. Netherlands will need wickets, and need them quickly!
A single again! On the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Misfield and two! Shorter and outside off, this is played towards point. The fielder lets it through. Two taken.
On the pads, this is flicked through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, Malan works it through square leg for a couple.
Floats it up outside off, this is hit through covers for one. The 100-run stand is up! Salt has been the aggressor and Malan has played second fiddle. A welcome one after Roy departed early.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Philippe Boissevain comes into the attack.

FOUR! EDGY! Shorter in length and outside off, Salt slashes at it, this goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence for a boundary. Not as wonderful as the previous one but the result is what Salt wanted.
FOUR! Creamed down the ground! That is a wonderful stroke! Fuller and on off, Salt shows the full face of the bat and times it down the ground for a boundary.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Slightly fuller and on off, this is driven to covers.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off. Malan thinks of a run but then sends Salt back.
On middle, Salt pushes it to mid on and takes a quick run.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Philip Salt drives it through cover for a single.
Quicker, flatter, on middle. Philip Salt defends it out.

FOUR! Philip Salt brings up his fifty in style! A loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Philip Salt advances down the track and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Second ODI fifty for Philip Salt! 50 in just 39 balls for him! Lovely knock so far.
Attacking the stumps, shorter ball. Philip Salt pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery, full, on the pads. Dawid Malan flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.

Successful review for England! A quicker ball, spinning in, around the leg pole. Dawid Malan gets down on his knee and tries to reverse-sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his front pad. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Dawid Malan opts for a review! No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates that was missing the leg pole! Dawid Malan survives.
FOUR! That will hurt Netherlands! A shorter ball, around middle. Philip Salt pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball, around middle and off. Philip Salt blocks it out.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! Netherlands have missed an opportunity here! A shorter ball, wide of off. Philip Salt slashes it flat and hard towards deep backward point. Shane Snater there runs forward and gets hands to the ball, but he spills it out it in the end. Two taken!
Length ball, around middle. Philip Salt shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Lovely delivery! Shorter ball, outside off. Philip Salt stays back and tries to cut this away but he gets beaten.
On a length, around middle and off. Philip Salt defends it out.
Wide! Shorter ball, down the leg side. Philip Salt swivels and looks to pull but he misses.
Beaten! Flatter, quicker, outside off. Dawid Malan looks to drive this but he misses. Good end to the over!
Tosses it up, serves it on a fuller length, around middle. Philip Salt pushes it through square leg for a single.
Very full, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan clips it past mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air, fuller ball, around middle. Philip Salt lifts it towards long on. Single taken!
Very full, around middle. Dawid Malan flicks it towards long on for a single.

FOUR BYES! A loopy ball, slower through the air, outside off. Dawid Malan misses his reverse-sweep. Scott Edwards fails to grab the ball as well. It rolls behind him all the way to the ropes for a boundary!
End of Powerplay1! It's time for Powerplay 2 now! A maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle.
On a length, around middle. Philip Salt blocks it out solidly. England are 67 for 1 at the end of the first Powerplay!
Angling in on a length, on the pads. Dawid Malan works it away towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Make that three wides in the over! Once again down the leg side, shorter ball. Dawid Malan looks to pull but he misses. Wide called!
Wide! Bas de Leede errs in line, he serves it down the leg side, on a length. Dawid Malan misses his flick and a wide is given! Second wide of the over!
Tad shorter, around off. Philip Salt pushes it off the back foot towards mid off for a single.
Angling in on a length, around middle and leg. Philip Salt flicks it off the back foot past square leg for a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Dawid Malan steers it past point for a single.
Beaten! Outside off, shaping away, fuller ball. Dawid Malan presses forward to drive this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Wide! Bas de Leede begins with a shorter ball, shaping away, down the leg side. Dawid Malan looks to pull this but he misses. Wide given!
Bas de Leede is brought into the attack.
Loopy ball, around middle, very full. Dawid Malan works it away towards long on for a single.
Tad shorter, around off. Dawid Malan pushes from within his crease towards cover.
Fuller, loopy one around middle and off. Dawid Malan flicks to the fielder at square leg.
Shorter now, around off. Philip Salt stays back and pushes it to long off. Single taken!
Slower through the air, very full, around middle. Dawid Malan knocks it down to long on for a single.
SIX! Up, up and away! Tosses this one up, fuller ball, around off. Dawid Malan shimmies down the pitch and tonks it high over long off for a biggie.
On a length, around middle. Philip Salt blocks it out.
FOUR! Gorgeous drive once again by Philip Salt! Tad fuller, around middle and off. Philip Salt drives it past mid on for a glorious boundary.
Another good-length delivery, around the leg pole. Dawid Malan shuffles across and works it towards deep square leg for a single.
Slower now, on a length, on middle. Dawid Malan defends it out solidly.
Excellent fielding! Pitched up delivery, outside off. Dawid Malan drives it wide of mid off. Logan van Beek there, dives to his right, stretches his right hand out, and makes a terrific stop there.
On a length, outside off. Philip Salt dabs it past point for a single.
Flatter one, outside off, full in length. Dawid Malan pushes it towards cover. 7 runs off Pieter Seelaar's first over!
Wide! He serves this one down the leg side. Dawid Malan misses his flick. Wide called!
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Dawid Malan pushes it back to the bowler.
Another loopy one, very full, around off. Philip Salt drives it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Slower through the air, loopy ball, around off. Philip Salt presses forward and caresses his drive through cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan reverse-sweeps this past short third man. Only a single!
Tosses it up, on the pads. Dawid Malan presses forward and clips it towards mid-wicket.
First bowling change for Netherlands! Pieter Seelaar brings himself into the attack!
Fuller ball, around middle. Philip Salt flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Darting it on the pads, on a length. Dawid Malan works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Angling in on a fuller length, around middle. Philip Salt pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle and off, at 129 clicks, extra bounce there as well. Philip Salt does well to keep it out.
Touch fuller, around off. Philip Salt leans and pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Length delivery, on the pads. Dawid Malan works it away towards fine leg for a single.

Three taken! Fullish ball, around middle and off. Dawid Malan shuffles across and flicks it past mid-wicket. Tom Cooper chases the ball, and does well to keep the ball away from the boundary ropes. He saved a certain single there! Another productive over for England!
On a length, outside off. Dawid Malan defends it towards cover.
Angling in on a fuller length, around middle. Philip Salt flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A length delivery, around middle and leg. Dawid Malan taps it towards mid on and takes a quick single.

FOUR! Top shot! Overpitched delivery, width on offer now. Dawid Malan presses forward and drives this past point. Philippe Boissevain runs to his left, puts in a dive, and tries to save the ball from crossing the ropes, but he fails to do so. Boundary!
Tad shorter, outside off, swinging away. Dawid Malan leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around off. Philip Salt stays in his crease and defends it out.
FOUR! Philip Salt is dealing only in boundaries here! Shane Snater drops it short, around middle. Philip Salt swivels and miscues his pull shot away from the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
A length delivery, around off. Philip Salt blocks it out.
Fuller ball, around off. Philip Salt leans to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
On a length, darting it on the pads. Philip Salt looks to flick this one but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
FOUR! Oh, shot! Glorious from Philip Salt! An overpitched delivery, around middle. Philip Salt presents the full face of his bat and drives it straight down the ground for a beautiful boundary.
Fuller ball, around middle. Philip Salt pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side. Philip Salt leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length, around middle. Philip Salt defends it out from within his crease.
SIX! BANG! Lovely shot! Too short on this occasion, outside off. Philip Salt swivels and pulls this high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Shorter in length, around middle. Philip Salt blocks it out off the back foot.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! A length delivery, shaping away just a tad, outside off. Philip Salt gets on top of the bounce and punches it past cover for a boundary.
Shorter ball now, shaping away, outside off. Philip Salt looks to cut this one but he misses.
Pitched up delivery, outside off. Philip Salt drives it uppishly over cover-point for three runs. End of a successful first over from Shane Snater!
Full in length, darting it on the pads. Dawid Malan flicks it towards deep square leg for a single. Dawid Malan gets off the mark with that!
Full again, around middle and off. Dawid Malan leans to drive but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto the pads.
Dawid Malan walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! An early breakthrough for Netherlands! This is just the start they wanted! Shane Snater strikes in his first over and he gets rid of the dangerous, Jason Roy! A lovely delivery! Full in length, nipping back in around middle. Jason Roy leans to drive but he gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps.
Another in-swinger, on a length, around middle. Jason Roy pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Well bowled! A length delivery, nipping back in, around middle and leg. Jason Roy looks to flick but he misses and gets hit high on his thigh pad.
Who will bowl from the other end? Shane Snater it is!
A length delivery, angling in around middle. Philip Salt taps it with soft hands towards mid-wicket. Tidy first over from Logan van Beek, just 1 run off it!
Pitches it up, swinging away, outside off. Philip Salt presses forward to drive but he misses.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg, at around 127 clicks. Jason Roy taps it towards mid on and takes a quick single. England and Jason Roy are up and running!
Length delivery, tailing back in around middle. Jason Roy defends it out.
This one angles in, on a length, around middle and leg. Jason Roy looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
Logan van Beek begins with a length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Jason Roy leaves it alone.
We are ready for action to begin! The players are out in the middle. Jason Roy and Philip Salt will open the batting for England. Logan van Beek will begin with the ball. Here we go!

Eoin Morgan, the skipper of England says that they would have chased as well, the conditions should remain the same. Adds that they have a talented young squad. On being asked about Matthew Mott, he says that it has been going very well, and he is someone who comes with a lot of clarity.

Pieter Seelaar the skipper of Netherlands says that they will bowl first, this is a nice ground to chase. Mentions that their middle-order needs to step up here and their main issue has been facing spin, but he hopes they can tackle it well here and they are looking to make improvements. Informs that they are playing two frontline spinners, as he thinks that there will be turn on this wicket.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, Eoin Morgan (C), Jos Buttler (WK), Liam Livingstone, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran, David Willey, Adil Rashid, Reece Topley.
Netherlands (Playing XI) - Vikramjit Singh, Max O'Dowd, Musa Ahmad, Bas de Leede,  Scott Edwards (WK), Pieter Seelaar (C), Logan van Beek, Philippe Boissevain, Tom Cooper, Shane Snater, Aryan Dutt.
TOSS - Netherlands have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

The hosts on the other hand have played a lot of cricket in 2022. However, things have not gone according to their plan. They are coming into this game after suffering a 3-0 defeat against West Indies. They have shown glimpses of how dangerous they can be but have failed to capitalize on their crunch moments. Players like Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd have been in sublime form, but their middle-order needs to step-up here. The Dutch need to put their A-game forward, as another loss will only make their chances slimmer for their World Cup qualification. Will the Dutch begin this series with a victory? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
